another one? can it freak drive and play the same Condemnation on a
different minion?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
freakdrivr wrote:
>
> Can a baali play a COndemnation on a minion, freak drive and play
> another one? can it freak drive and play the same Condemnation on a
> different minion?

Yes. No. This is covered in the NRA rules. [VEKN 6.4.1]
Look for "by card name".

> also is the superior effect of Betrayed cumulative? ie. Betrayed's on
> different minions of the same methuselah?

All cards are cumulative by default.
